paragraphs: Bava Batra 32b relates that a report spread about him that he was consuming orphans’ land. Abaye said to him: “Tell me the actual facts of the case,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The saved whole William Davidson Bava Batra 32b paragraph reports a rumor about Rava bar Sharshom consuming orphans’ land, followed by Abaye asking him for the facts. The rumor is not converted into an established accusation, and the omitted explanation is not imported.
